tasks.label: Run Easy1Line on iPad Simulator
tasks.command: open -a Simulator && sleep 2 && xcrun simctl boot 075D7EEB-0A56-49BA-BC6B-C569D8146FA2 2>/dev/null || true; xcrun simctl bootstatus 075D7EEB-0A56-49BA-BC6B-C569D8146FA2 -b && xcodebuild -project Easy1Line.xcodeproj -scheme Easy1Line -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=075D7EEB-0A56-49BA-BC6B-C569D8146FA2' build && xcrun simctl install 075D7EEB-0A56-49BA-BC6B-C569D8146FA2 ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/Easy1Line-*/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/Easy1Line.app && xcrun simctl launch 075D7EEB-0A56-49BA-BC6B-C569D8146FA2 MazzWebdesign.Easy1Line

tasks.label: Run Easy1Line on connected iPad
tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/Easy1Line-device-build && xcodebuild -project Easy1Line.xcodeproj -scheme Easy1Line -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS,id=00008101-0002290C360B001E' -derivedDataPath /tmp/Easy1Line-device-build build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device EA47FC60-AEB0-5489-A0C0-4967ADDCC083 /tmp/Easy1Line-device-build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Easy1Line.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device EA47FC60-AEB0-5489-A0C0-4967ADDCC083 MazzWebdesign.Easy1Line

tasks.label: Run Easy1Line on Mac
tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build && xcodebuild -project Easy1Line.xcodeproj -scheme Easy1Line -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst' -derivedDataPath /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build build && open /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build/Build/Products/Debug-maccatalyst/Easy1Line.app

tasks.label: Install Easy1Line to Applications
tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build && xcodebuild -project Easy1Line.xcodeproj -scheme Easy1Line -configuration Release -destination 'platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst' -derivedDataPath /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build build && mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications" && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/Easy1Line.app" && ditto /tmp/Easy1Line-mac-build/Build/Products/Release-maccatalyst/Easy1Line.app "$HOME/Applications/Easy1Line.app" && open -R "$HOME/Applications/Easy1Line.app"
